connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package globalrules-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the yk647 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.

env.description: Your EVM wallet private key (0x + 64 hex), used to sign x402 USDC payments on Base mainnet. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet funded with a few USDC.

env.description: Optional override of the GlobalRules API base URL. Default: https://globalrules-api.onrender.com
